question: What observance must accompany recitation of the gāyatrī and root mantra?
premises: The gāyatrī and root mantra are recited.
The observance is eating only at night.
inference: After reciting the gāyatrī and root mantra, one should observe eating only at night.
plain_english: Having recited the gāyatrī and the root mantra, one should eat only at night.
